title: Thousands of Businesses Close Under Milei's Austerity and Deregulation Program
detail: Thousands of businesses are closing across Argentina under President Milei's economic program, raising questions about the structural effects of austerity and deregulation on the private sector. The wave of closures reflects the painful adjustment costs of Milei's shock-therapy approach, even as the government touts macroeconomic stabilization gains.

media.caption: Businesses closing across Argentina amid Milei austerity program
